title: Runs agree when transitions agree on visited states
statement: Let $M$ and $N$ be multi-tape Turing machines with the same number of work tapes, symbol alphabet, and state set, and let $Q$ be a set of states. Suppose their transition functions agree at every state in $Q$, for every input symbol and tuple of scanned work-tape symbols. For a fixed input word, configuration $c$, and time $t\in\mathbb{N}$, suppose that at every time $u<t$, if the state of the configuration reached by $M$ from $c$ after $u$ steps is some state $q$, then $q\in Q$. Then the configurations reached by $M$ and $N$ after $t$ steps from $c$ are equal.
